notes: Reference date 2018-02-24. Main campus for this record: LIU Post (Brookville), per the Post agreement's version note; Brooklyn Campus provisions recorded with faculty_group naming the Brooklyn unit (V3b), not counted.
2018_01_hr_labor_relations_page holds no policy: an index listing Brooklyn Faculty (LIUFF), Pharmacy Faculty (AAUP/AMS), Post Faculty (Collegial Federation) and Post Adjunct Faculty (CWA) agreements.

Version: the Post agreement (2011-2016) was extended to 2019-09-01 by the May 2015 memorandum bound in the PDF, which changes only salary and fringe benefits, so Art. XVI (leaves) is in force on the reference date. The Brooklyn agreement runs 2016-09-01 to 2021-08-31. The HR FMLA page is a 2018-03-13 capture (reference academic year 2017-18).
Calendar: semesters ('nine (9) credit hours per semester'); no term length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No counted component is stated in semesters.

Birth parent chain (Post): maternity leave 6 weeks paid (2 before the expected birth + 4 after) -> child-care leave up to 1 year unpaid (also_available: no order stated, placed after); FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent_with both from the start. Paid sick leave (generic plan, 2 months at two years of service) is not linked to the maternity leave; for tenured members unpaid sick leave follows it.
Non-birth parent chain (Post): child-care leave up to 1 year unpaid; FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent_with it from the start. No paid leave for the non-birth parent.

Brooklyn (not counted): infant care leave up to 1 year unpaid; childbirth handled through sick leave ('maternity will be treated as any other disability or illness'), one month per year of service up to six months.

Post Art. XVI §6: members on child-care leave receive on return the salary increases that would have accrued, and the time counts toward seniority and longevity (recorded in c2's description; not a leave).

Not components (cannot be used for a birth, or not leave): sabbatical and faculty development leaves (research purposes), jury duty, military leave, union-officer leave, leave for administrative appointment, death benefits, tuition remission.

Cited but not saved: LTD Summary Plan Description (both agreements); Earned Sick Time Policy (HR policies menu); Pharmacy Faculty (AAUP/AMS) and Post Adjunct Faculty (CWA) agreements (Labor Relations index; not main-campus tenure-stream faculty); memorandum of understanding of September 25, 2003 (doctoral released time); LIU Patent Procedures.
The HR FMLA policy says a collective agreement's family and medical leave policy governs where more generous; neither agreement has an FMLA policy of its own.
